summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload on install
details: The package advertises itself as a React chat UI library but ships a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) whose script is obfuscated with rotating hex-named identifiers and string-lookup indirection. On install, `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/`, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it via `execFileSync` to run a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-bundled script (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) obfuscated with a large mixed number/char array and a rotating-array string decoder, containing no readable URLs or purpose strings. Fetching an alternate JS runtime at install time to execute an opaque, obfuscated sibling script is unrelated to the package's declared UI purpose and produces arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine during `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
